system.description:
Mighty Set himself has foretold your coming, and it is whispered among the elders that you figure prominently in one or more of the Prophecies of Set. This mark of destiny carries great weight among devout Setites, but also makes you a prize sought by ambitious elders hoping to bask in the reflected glow of Set's favor. The prophecies in question may not come to pass for centuries, but your fate will not be denied.

This is a variable Merit, its cost representing the perceived importance of your role. Each Trait purchased allows you to cancel a single botch during a given story, but also raises your clan's expectations of you — and the Storyteller may decide that one of the prophecies concerning you is soon to come to pass, making you the locus of events you may or may not control. This Merit does not grant any real authority among other Setites; for that, you must purchase the Status Background.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Three: Serpents
